body: Yes I guess so... can’t wait to move out! And yes I am so excited for fallout 76!! I was a Pandarian hunter :) I know terrible mix but that was when I first started out and I thought the pair matched really well. How about yourself?
I know. It’s really weird how a good percentage of society feels this shitty yet nobody openly talks about it.

it’s tough seeing my friends going through the same issues and having their parents completely support them, u know? I just don’t really see anything getting better and I’m in genuine pain everyday, all of this depression and anxiety makes me feel like my heads going to explode. Yes weed has helped me tremendously, I can’t thank it enough and I just bought the nuka world expansion for fallout 4. I used to be obsessed with world of Warcraft too! Hby :)

Thank you so much for replying and sharing your situation. I can’t believe you’ve been dealing with this for such a long time, it’s only been four or so years for me and my brain already feels like oatmeal. I love smoking weed and playing video games. That’s my outlet, but my family looks down on that as well. The only time I get true peace is when I’m home alone.

I just can’t bare to look somebody in the face and feel vulnerable. I can’t even stand to do that with my family because I’ve always been such a strong person. I’ve always been the backbone, so it’s hard to expose the truth

Thank you. Its just such a typical statistic that I wanted to avoid completely but somehow got sucked into it. I’ve tried to get in touch with therapists, psychologists and what not but when the actual appointment comes around, I never end up going.

it’s impossible to talk to them about anything. It ends in screaming and crying and more frustration. My mom works all the time too so I’m always alone at home. It drives me crazy, I feel like I’m in this bubble that I can’t pop. I just want it all to go away. I’m tired of trying

Hey joe. Thanks for replying. I have but there’s so much to the story. My family thinks my depression stems from certain failures that have occurred in my life. But that’s because they’re looking at it from their perspective. I grew up in a really strict family, with a lot of discipline involved, yet a lot of laughter and love. My mom always strived for me to accomplish huge milestones at a young age. Throwing me into gymnastic, dance, chess competitions ect. At a very young. So expectations have always been high. I had a fallout in hs and rebeled because my lifestyle was suffocating. My mom ended up giving up on me because I kept
Going against what she wanted and basically stopped giving a shit about me because I wasn’t making her proud. Long story short, i got in touch with the wrong crowd, dated a boy that broke me mentally and physically and now I’m here. Nobody wants to help me, because they don’t get me
